selection_method: Twenty manually chosen calibration boundary/domain cases followed by deterministic even-spacing within fixed sheet and historical-V2-classification strata. Historical classification and risk fields are used only to ensure coverage and BLOCKED/high-risk weighting; they are not accepted as V3 judgments. The pilot is not a representative estimate of all 3,112 cases.
